ApplyConfig.description:
POST /virtuals/apply-config: write these settings into every running
effect that has them (default: on all virtuals). flip and mirror are
explicit booleans: v2 has no "toggle".
ApplyConfig.title: ApplyConfig

ApplyConfigCounts.description:
Effects updated, skipped (they have none of the settings) and failed
(they refused the settings).
ApplyConfigCounts.title: ApplyConfigCounts

CopyEffect.description:
POST /virtuals/{virtual_id}/copy-effect: start this virtual's effect,
with its settings, on the targets.
CopyEffect.title: CopyEffect

info.description: Clients must ignore unknown fields in responses: new response fields are additive. Requests are strict.
info.title: LedFx API

get.description:
The ETag is the sha256 of the body. Send it back in If-None-Match to get
a 304 while the API is unchanged.
get.summary: The OpenAPI 3.1 document for this API.
Get the server's name, version and API versions.

post.description:
Its id is made from the name (lowercase, other characters as "-") and
made unique with a numeric suffix. The new virtual has no segments.

A gradient also sets the colours sampled from it, except those given. Each
running effect is counted as updated, skipped (it has none of the settings)
or failed (it refused them). 404 if an id in virtual_ids does not exist
(nothing is written).
post.summary: Write settings into every running effect that has them.

post.description:
Runtime only: their stored effects come back when LedFx restarts. 404 if an
id does not exist (nothing is cleared).
post.summary: Blank the output of these virtuals (default: all).
Fill every device's own virtual with a colour.
Flash every active virtual with a colour.

post.description:
Without config the type's defaults start. An unknown virtual id is a 404
and nothing starts. A virtual that refuses the effect (no segments) counts
as failed; with fallback_s, one that is being streamed to counts as
blocked.
post.summary: Start one effect on these virtuals (default: all).

delete.description: A device's own virtual takes its device with it. Scenes forget it.

patch.description:
Only the fields sent change; a config object merges into the current one,
and segments replace the list. All or nothing: a 4xx means nothing
changed. Values are never adjusted: a segment must name a known device
and pixels inside it (start not after end), frequency_min must be below
frequency_max, and rotate needs more than one row; anything else is 422.
Those bounds apply to what the change sets: a stored setting it leaves
alone is kept even if it lies outside them.
patch.summary: Change a virtual's settings, segments or active state.

put.summary: Turn calibration mode, where highlights show, on or off.

post.description:
404 if a target does not exist (nothing is copied). Targets that refuse
the effect are passed over; 409 if none takes it, or if this virtual runs
nothing.
post.summary: Start this virtual's effect, with its settings, on the targets.

delete.summary: Stop the effect. Its settings stay in the history.

get.description:
A stored effect whose type is no longer registered shows as an
UnknownPlugin (available: false); it cannot run.
get.summary: Get the virtual's effect: its type and settings, or null.

patch.description:
The settings are checked against the running effect's type. A setting
the change leaves alone is kept even if it lies outside the bounds v2
accepts in a request. A colour
change on an effect that blends colours restarts it, so it fades in.
Restarting the effect makes the virtual active.
patch.summary: Change some settings of the running effect.

put.description:
config is checked against the type's settings; without it the settings
this virtual last used for the type apply (409 if they no longer pass
the type's checks). With fallback_s the current effect comes back after
that many seconds (409 if the virtual is being streamed to). Starting an
effect makes the virtual active.

post.summary: Give the running effect random settings (brightness stays).
Restart the running effect with its default settings.

get.summary: List the settings the virtual last used for each effect type.

delete.description: 404 for a type the virtual has neither stored nor running.
delete.summary: Forget an effect type's settings, stopping it if it is running.

post.summary: End a temporary (fallback_s) effect now: the previous one comes back.
Fill the virtual with a colour until its effect draws again.

delete.summary: Turn the highlight off (204 whether or not the virtual is calibrating).

put.summary: Light a device's pixels on a calibrating virtual (409 otherwise).

post.summary: Flash the virtual with a colour (409 if it is not active).
